notes.title: New Previews and Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thanks to those who played the demo and wishlisted the game over the last week!

We apologise to those who were unable to launch it. An error impacted some players, as the install folder contained the letter "ó". We have now replaced this with "o" removing the accent.

If you were impacted and installed the demo before Sunday, please uninstall and reinstall it so that the demo launches correctly.

We're working hard towards the upcoming launch. For today's post, we'll share a few new preview images.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Development Update & Previews!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It's been a while since we've shared a development update here on Steam.

We've been working hard to release early access updates on other platforms in preparation for the full Steam launch.

We are approaching the end of development of High Lathión's main story.

Once this is complete, we will implement the in-game side paths for numerous characters. We may release on Steam before completing all character side paths and then to add the remaining ones as a free update shortly after release.

We hope to launch High Lathión on Steam within the next two months. We will confirm specific release dates within the next few weeks.

The development cycle for this Realm has been far more ambitious than Realms 1 & 2. We hope that comes through to you in the overall quality of this new Realm. We are incredibly excited to share it with you all soon.

In the build-up to the launch, we plan to share more posts with information on the development and the lore surrounding The Seven Realms.

Today, we're sharing various image previews below. Thanks for your patience while we're working hard on finalising this Realm. We cannot wait to release it for you all to play!

If you haven't already, please consider wishlisting the game. It helps us out massively when you do. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Realm 2: Pythonium - Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're excited to announce the Realm 2 release date as the 21st of September.

We have a few more things to finalise. Once done, we will apply the finishing touches and play-test.

If you haven't done so, please consider wishlisting the DLC, as it helps us out massively!

In the meantime, we have a few more previews to share below.

Thanks for your support. We can't wait to share Realm 2 with you very soon!

notes.title: Realm 2: Pythonium - Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We want to give you a quick update on the current development of Realm 2 and the release date.

We have decided to push the release until August/September. A specific date will be communicated nearer the time. We recently lost our programmer from the project, which was a setback for us. Now with our current developer, we're working on a save export system, allowing you to export your saves safely to Realm 3 upon completion of Realm 2.

We also drastically raised the image and animation quality halfway through the development of Realm 2. We're now working on changing the lighting and quality of the first half. We've posed all the renders and animations for Realm 2. It is now just a case of lighting, rendering and enhancing these. We decided to increase the scope of the finale of Realm 2 by adding many more renders and animations (which made the finale of Realm 2 twice as big as planned), which delayed our release plans.

We don't regret this, as we think they will drastically improve the finale. However, we do apologise for the delay that it will cause.

In the meantime, we thought you would like to see new previews of Realm 2: Pythonium.

Thanks for all the support, everyone.
SeptCloud

notes.title: Realm 1 Update
notes.notes:
Hey everybody,

We have released an update to The Seven Realms - Realm 1.

The biggest change here is the addition of a Simplified Chinese translation!
All other changes are detailed below:

 Corrected two untranslated lines in Russian and Spanish.
 A pop-up will now appear when you unlock a new gallery scene or music track.
 You can now save your favourite in-game images by clicking the heart icon on the top right of the screen. This will save the image. All favourited images are viewable in the Extras/Favourites Menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/e8de72c44225b27f68f456750e5c1c843a2d8e47.png
If you haven't already, please wishlist Realm 2: Pythonium. Realm 2 will be a DLC to the base game, and once purchased, you can continue from your existing saves. You wishlisting it really helps us out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/200e47f89acacbcfc209e90507edf8496e62130c.jpg
Thanks for playing, and have a great day!
SeptCloud

notes.title: Realm 2: Pythonium - Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody,

The store page for The Seven Realms - Realm 2: Pythonium is now live.

Realm 2 will be a DLC to the base game, and once purchased, you can continue from your existing saves. The targeted release date is the end of July 2023.

We are hard at work on developing Realm 2. We've largely improved our image and animation quality when compared to Realm 1, and we are incredibly excited to share these improvements with you.

Below, we've included a few previews of in-game images and our new trailer. All animations from the trailer will appear in the game!

If you can wishlist the game, you will be really helping us out!
